dialogue.origin: （こんばんは、本日はよろしくお願いいたします。時間になりましたら始めさせていただきますね。）
dialogue.content: (Good evening. Thank you for your time today. We'll get started at the scheduled time.)

dialogue.origin: (こんばんは。よろしくお願いいたします。)
dialogue.content: (Good evening. Thank you for having me.)

dialogue.origin: こんばんは、相談員です。始めに性別、年齢、相談内容を教えてください。
dialogue.content: Good evening, I'm the counselor. To begin, could you please tell me your gender, age, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: こんばんは。よろしくお願いします。16歳、女、学校での悩みについてです。
dialogue.content: Good evening. Thank you. I'm 16, female, and I'd like to talk about some problems I'm having at school.

dialogue.origin: ご回答ありがとうございます。学校の悩みという事ですが、どんなことがあったのかお話聞いてもいいですか？
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that. You mentioned you're having problems at school; would you mind telling me a little about what's been happening?

dialogue.origin: 4月から部活を始めたのですが、部活の先輩から嫌なことをされたり影で悪口や私の前でも嫌なことを言ってきたりとても辛いです。
dialogue.content: I joined a club in April, but the upperclassmen in the club have been doing mean things to me. They say bad things about me behind my back and even say nasty things to my face. It's very painful.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。それは毎日辛いですよね。何かきっかけなどあったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. That must be very difficult to deal with every day. Do you know if anything happened that might have started this?

dialogue.origin: 分かりません。ちょっと前までは別の子がターゲットのようになって悪口言われてました。少し思い当たるのは.その子と話をしていたことかな。とはおもうけど...
dialogue.content: I don't know. Until recently, another girl was their target, and they were bad-mouthing her. The only thing I can think of is that maybe it's because I was talking to that girl. But I'm not sure...

dialogue.origin: 明確なことは分からないです。
dialogue.content: I don't know for certain.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。その先輩はいつもターゲットを見つけては嫌がらせをするということなのですね。とても苦しい思いをされていると思いますが、いかがですか？
dialogue.content: I see. So it sounds like these upperclassmen are always finding someone to target and harass. You must be in a lot of pain. How are you feeling?

dialogue.origin: 苦しいです
dialogue.content: It's painful.

dialogue.origin: 学校も行きたくありません
dialogue.content: I don't want to go to school.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。学校は毎日ありますものね。本当に不安で、いっぱいだと思います。ちなみに先輩からの嫌がらせで怪我などはないですか？
dialogue.content: That makes sense. School is every day, after all. I imagine you're feeling really anxious and overwhelmed. By the way, have you been injured at all from the harassment from the seniors?

dialogue.origin: 怪我とかはありません。
dialogue.content: No, I haven't been injured.

dialogue.origin: 暴力とかは...ないです。
dialogue.content: There hasn't been... any violence.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、少し安心しました。学校に行きたくないことや、部活でのことはお友達には話したりしたことはありますか？
dialogue.content: I see. I'm a little relieved to hear that. Have you talked to any of your friends about not wanting to go to school or about what's happening in the club?

dialogue.origin: 友だちと言っても.いつも部活の友だちとずっと居たので複雑な気持ちです。話したことないと言うか...多分部活の友だちなので分かっている...と思います。
dialogue.content: Well, when you say friends... I was always with my friends from the club, so it feels complicated. It's not so much that I haven't talked to them... since they're my club friends, they probably already know... I think.

dialogue.origin: 部活以外の他の友達には言ったことないです。
dialogue.content: I haven't told any of my friends outside the club.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。おしえてくださってありがとうございます。部活以外での学校生活は楽しいですか？
dialogue.content: I see. Thank you for sharing that with me. Do you enjoy school life outside of your club activities?

dialogue.origin: 楽しくないです。
dialogue.content: No, it's not enjoyable.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。毎日勉強は大変ですものね。部活のこともありながら毎日ちゃんと学校に通われている。とても偉いなと思います。
dialogue.content: I understand. Studying every day is tough, isn't it? And you're still going to school every day despite what's happening in the club. I think that's very admirable.

dialogue.origin: 実はここ数日行けてないんです。
dialogue.content: Actually, I haven't been able to go for the past few days.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。心が一番大切ですから、休むのは賢明な判断だと思いますよ。
dialogue.content: I see. Your mental health is the most important thing, so I think taking a break is a very wise decision.

dialogue.origin: ご家族は心配されているかと思いますが、いかがですか？
dialogue.content: I imagine your family might be worried. How are things with them?

dialogue.origin: いずれかは何で休んでるか...って家族にもバレたりすると思うと嫌で。1日はお腹痛いと言って休んで1日は学校に普通に行くと言って学校へは行けなかったり
dialogue.content: I hate the thought that my family will eventually find out why I'm absent... One day I said I had a stomachache to stay home, and another day I said I was going to school like normal but couldn't bring myself to go.

dialogue.origin: 何かおかしい。とは感じていても聞いてきたことはないです。
dialogue.content: They might sense that something is off, but they haven't asked me about it.

dialogue.origin: ご家族に心配をかけたくない気持ちもありますものね。とても苦しい状況が続いてしまうと相談者様の身体が心配ですが、相談者様はこの辛い状況をご家族に話せますか？
dialogue.content: It's natural not to want to worry your family. I'm concerned about your well-being if this very difficult situation continues. Do you feel able to talk with your family about what you're going through?

dialogue.origin: みんな仕事に忙しそうで迷惑かけたくなくてまだ言えてません。
dialogue.content: Everyone seems busy with work, and I don't want to be a burden, so I haven't been able to tell them yet.

dialogue.origin: ご家族は、とてもお忙しいのですね。そうでしたか、、、相談者様の悩みは部活のことだけでしょうか？他に友達関係などありますか？
dialogue.content: So your family is very busy. I see... Is the trouble you're facing only related to the club, or are there also issues with friendships and such?

dialogue.origin: 多分部活の件から友だちも先輩も誰を信じたらいいか分からないんです
dialogue.content: I think because of this issue with the club, I don't know who I can trust anymore, whether it's friends or the upperclassmen.

dialogue.origin: だから怖くて
dialogue.content: That's why I'm scared.

dialogue.origin: ええ、疑心暗鬼になってしまうのも当然だと思いますよ。部活の先輩からどんなことを言われたりしたのでしょうか？いいたくなければ、大丈夫ですよ。
dialogue.content: Yes, it's completely natural to feel suspicious of everyone in this situation. What kinds of things have the upperclassmen in the club said to you? If you'd rather not say, that's perfectly fine.

dialogue.origin: キモイとか、来なきゃいいとか
dialogue.content: Things like, "You're disgusting," or "You shouldn't even come here."

dialogue.origin: 邪魔。
dialogue.content: "You're in the way."

dialogue.origin: とか
dialogue.content: Things like that.

dialogue.origin: そんなことを言われてしまったのですね。それは傷付きますね。何も悪くない相談者様にそんなことをいう方が良くない人間性に私は思いました。
dialogue.content: So they said those things to you. That is very hurtful. I feel that the people who say such things to you, when you've done nothing wrong, are the ones with questionable character.

dialogue.origin: 相談者様は、どんなふうになったら一番楽になりますか？
dialogue.content: What do you think would make you feel the most at ease?

dialogue.origin: 楽...どこにいても楽になれるのか分からないですが学校に行きたくない。今はそれが一番です。
dialogue.content: At ease... I'm not sure if I can feel at ease anywhere, but right now, I just don't want to go to school. That's the main thing.

dialogue.origin: 例えば、部活から離れることができたらどうですか？
dialogue.content: For example, how would you feel if you could leave the club?

dialogue.origin: 部活から離れても、クラスの友だちには一緒の部活の友だちがいるので、気まずいです。勇気がでません。
dialogue.content: Even if I left the club, some of my friends in my class are also in the club, so it would be awkward. I can't muster the courage.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。色々と複雑な状況があるからこそ悩んでいらっしゃるんですものね。今日は、一緒に少しでも相談者様の心が軽くなればと思います。
dialogue.content: I see. It's because of these various complexities that you're struggling, isn't it? Today, I hope that together, we can make you feel even a little bit lighter.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに、部活の先生はそのことは知っているのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: By the way, does the club advisor know about this?

dialogue.origin: とても厳しい先生で、相談したことありません。
dialogue.content: They're a very strict teacher, so I've never consulted them.

dialogue.origin: 言ったらまた先輩になにされるか。、、
dialogue.content: If I told them, who knows what the upperclassmen would do to me next...

dialogue.origin: 厳しい・・・そうですよね。例えば間接的に話せる先生や保健の先生には相談できそうですか？
dialogue.content: Strict... I understand. For example, do you think you could talk to a different teacher you feel comfortable with, or perhaps the school nurse?

dialogue.origin: どの先生に話しても結局先輩たちの耳に入れば告げ口された、、、と言われそうで怖くて。
dialogue.content: No matter which teacher I talk to, if it eventually reaches the seniors, I'm afraid they'd say I snitched on them...

dialogue.origin: 学校が辛いということも含めて、気持ちだけでも吐き出せるところが必要かと思いました。
dialogue.content: I felt that you need a place where you can at least let your feelings out, including how hard school is for you.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。、、
dialogue.content: You're right...

dialogue.origin: なるほど。1人でその辛さを抱えているのも限界がきてしまって心が壊れてしまわないかと心配です。
dialogue.content: I see. I'm worried that holding all this pain alone might reach a breaking point and harm your mental health.

dialogue.origin: 例えばなのですが・・
dialogue.content: For example...

dialogue.origin: 今は、いろいろな学校もありますし学校に行かない選択もあると私は思います。今は個性の時代でもありますし。
dialogue.content: These days, there are all kinds of different schools, and I believe that choosing not to go to school is also an option. It's an era of individuality, after all.

dialogue.origin: そこで、
dialogue.content: So,

dialogue.origin: 思い切って、学校を休んでその中で相談者様がどうしたいのか考えをご家族に伝えるのはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: how about taking a bold step to take a break from school and, during that time, share with your family what you want to do?

dialogue.origin: 今まで1人で苦しんできた相談者様だからこそ、傷の癒える時間にして欲しいと思いました。更にこの先長い人生ですから、考える時間がよりいい時間になると私は思います。
dialogue.content: Especially since you've been suffering alone until now, I thought you should take some time for your wounds to heal. You have a long life ahead of you, so I believe this time for reflection will be very beneficial.

dialogue.origin: 嫌な思いをさせてしまったでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Did I make you feel uncomfortable?

dialogue.origin: カウンセラーさんの言葉からなかなか答えが出せなくて。すみません。考えたくない気持ちの方が大きくて...いい時間になるなんて思える日が来るのかな..と思いました。
dialogue.content: I'm finding it hard to come up with an answer to what you've said. I'm sorry. The feeling of not wanting to think about it is just too strong... It made me wonder if a day will ever come when I can think of it as a "beneficial time."

dialogue.origin: ええ、そんなにすぐには考えられなくて当然です。
dialogue.content: Yes, it's completely natural that you can't think about it that quickly.

dialogue.origin: 今は、ご家族に学校をお休みすることだけ伝えられたらいいのかなと思いますがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: For now, I wonder if it might be enough just to tell your family that you will take a break from school—how would that feel?

dialogue.origin: 逃げてるみたいで嫌な気持ちもあります。けど、それ以上に怖くて。お休みしたいことだけ話すのなら勇気を出せそうです。
dialogue.content: I do feel bad, like I'm running away. But I'm more scared than anything. If it's just talking about wanting to take a break, I think I could work up the courage for that.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。怖いですよね。でも全く逃げてなんかいないですよ。ここに来て相談者様は勇気を持って相談に来てくれています。
dialogue.content: I understand. It is scary. But you are not running away at all. You've shown great courage by coming here to talk with me.

dialogue.origin: ぜひ、勇気を出してご家族に休むことを伝えてみてください。
dialogue.content: Please do find the courage to let your family know you need to take a break.

dialogue.origin: 伝えてみます。
dialogue.content: I'll try to tell them.

dialogue.origin: そして、どのようになったか次回教えてくださいね。
dialogue.content: And please let me know next time how it went.

dialogue.origin: 休むことを伝えてどうなったか？ですよね。頑張ってみます。
dialogue.content: You mean how it went after I told them I want to take a break, right? I'll do my best.

dialogue.origin: それももちろんですが、まだまだ、いろんな悩みが出てくると思います。またその時に、一緒に考えさせてくださいね。
dialogue.content: That, of course, but I'm sure various other concerns will come up. When that happens, please let me help you think things through together again.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: いえいえ、こちらこそ。勇気を持って相談してくださってありがとうございました。ゆっくり心を癒して、ご飯もしっかり召し上がって未来のための力をつけてくださいね。
dialogue.content: Not at all, thank you. Thank you for having the courage to talk to me. Take your time to heal your heart, eat well, and build your strength for the future.

dialogue.origin: 出来ること頑張ってみます。
dialogue.content: I'll do my best with what I can.

dialogue.origin: はい。時間になりましたので、終了させていただきますね。またぜひお待ちしています。
dialogue.content: Okay. Our time is up for today, so we'll have to end here. I'll be looking forward to our next session.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: （ありがとうございました）
dialogue.content: (Thank you.)

dialogue.origin: (お疲れ様でした。貴重な体験をありがとうございました)
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your time. Thank you for this valuable experience.)
